#  31407 - Applied Mechanics Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **31407 - module is no longer offered from WS 2008/9**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Applied Mechanics**  |  
|  Angewandte Mechanik   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. habil. Bestle, Dieter 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students have to develop the ability to abstract technical problems and the mathematical calculus for solution  |  
| Contents:  | General principles, equivalence and equilibrium of force systems, center of gravity, analysis of statically determinate systems of rigid bodies and structures, intersection forces and moments in beams, elasto-statics, stress and strain, Hocke’s law, tension, torsion, bending  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Seminar / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Manuscript, experiments, booklet of exercise problems  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Manuscript, experiments, booklet of exercise problems  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
